articles.title: Kalshi turns to small businesses as legal battles threaten forecasts on sports
articles.snippet: The prediction market is pitching protection against tariffs, weather and other business risks as courts challenge its ability to offer sports wagers.

articles.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
articles.snippet: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

articles.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
articles.snippet: The breach exposed client and employee contact information at Standard Chartered's crypto custodian, which said no unauthorized transactions took place.

articles.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
articles.snippet: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.
